output.headline: Evolent Health has done three deals, all in the target's own Health IT sub-sector, all closed, at prices close to the comparable median.
output.differentiator: All 3 deals are in the target's own sub-sector, and all closed. Its 21.6x median paid is just above the 21.4x comparable median and above every financial sponsor on the list.
output.why_them: Pure Health IT buyer; three for three closed; pays median-plus

acquirer_overview.title: A Health IT strategic with three closed deals, 2018 to 2022
points: Strategic buyer with 3 deals between 2018 and 2022, all closed: 3 of 3 (100%) [T:record, K:closed_share].
All 3 deals are in the target's own sub-sector; none are adjacent or outside Health IT [K:by_sub_sector, T:record].
Ranked 1 on the priority list of 10, from 107 buyers scored, with a likelihood of 5.6% [R:rank].

strategic_fit_thesis.title: Sub-sector focus is the strongest factor behind this match
points: Share of its deals in the target's sub-sector is the strongest factor; target margin close to what it usually buys is a strong factor [S:sector_share, S:margin_fit].
Technology Capability drove 3 of 3 deals, a motive on only 10% of deals in the file, so it is a distinct pattern [M:technology_capability].
Margin Improvement also drove 3 of 3 deals, consistent with a target running a 25.0% margin [M:margin_improvement].

precedent_activity.title: Three Health IT precedents at 19.8x to 22.4x, one near target size
points: Frontier Health AI, $325M, 2022, Recapitalization, 19.8x EBITDA; closed, and its one deal in the comparable size band [D:MA-2022-0353, K:size_band].
Eastern EHR Solutions, $31M, 2022, Strategic Acquisition, 22.4x EBITDA, closed [D:MA-2022-0458].
Southwest EHR Solutions, $37M, 2018, Minority Investment, 21.6x EBITDA, closed [D:MA-2018-0149].

valuation_context.title: A median anchor of 21.4x matches Evolent's own 21.6x pricing
points: 13 comparable deals, all in the same sub-sector: 19.4x at the lower quartile, 21.4x median, 23.3x at the upper quartile [V:comps].
Target margin of 25.0% is above the comps' median of 22.2% but not in their top quarter, so the 50th percentile is defensible [V:comps].
Evolent's median paid is 21.6x; synergy headroom is $14M-$23M, but buyer revenue is not researched, so capacity is unconfirmed [V:comps, V:synergy].

risk_flags.title: Size stretch
risk_flags.concern: Median deal of $37M is far below a $300M target; only 1 of 3 deals sat in the size band [T:record, K:size_band].
risk_flags.mitigant: Its biggest deal, Frontier Health AI at $325M, was above the target's size [D:MA-2022-0353].
risk_flags.reality: That $325M deal was a recapitalization, not an outright acquisition, so full-control scale is unproven [D:MA-2022-0353].

risk_flags.title: Ability to pay unverified
risk_flags.concern: Buyer revenue is not researched, so funding capacity cannot be tested [V:synergy].
risk_flags.mitigant: Synergy headroom of $14M-$23M supports a bid near the median multiple [V:synergy].
risk_flags.reality: Capacity needs confirming before the call; the profile has not been researched [V:synergy].

risk_flags.title: Thin recent record and competition
risk_flags.concern: Deals in recent years are a slight factor against, and no deal sits in the target's region [S:recency, T:record].
risk_flags.reality: Epic Systems and Blackstone also carry High conviction, so Evolent will face strong rivals [R:rank].

conviction.rationale: Three deals in the target's own sub-sector and a #1 place on the priority list after review support High; the absence of any deal in the target's region is neutral. [T:record, R:rank, C:conviction]
